items.detail: Use the number on the back of your card or on the bank's official website or app, not a number the scammer gave you. Ask them to stop or reverse the payment and to flag it as fraud.
items.title: Call your bank or card issuer now

items.detail: Freeze or cancel the card in your banking app, or ask the bank to do it on the call.

items.detail: Change the password of any account you used or shared with the scammer and turn on two-step verification.
